svg.aria-label: Landora system architecture: an installable Next.js PWA talks to one Next.js app server made of modular packages (ingest, rules, search, AI router, analytics, billing), backed by one PostgreSQL database with PostGIS and pgvector. External systems sit behind adapters. Solid boxes are built in the prototype, dashed boxes are mocked, dotted boxes are planned.
